name: argo
title: Argo
description: Continue existing Agent sessions through Argo bridges or control Herdr terminals directly in Raycast.
author: fernando_jacob

commands.name: sessions
commands.title: Agent Sessions
commands.subtitle: Argo
commands.description: Browse Argo and Herdr sessions, view output, send tasks, and respond to prompts inside Raycast.

commands.name: recent
commands.title: Recent Agent Session
commands.subtitle: Argo
commands.description: Continue the last session opened in Argo.

commands.name: connect
commands.title: Connect a Server
commands.subtitle: Argo
commands.description: Start with an uninstalled Agent, discover ordinary forwarded ports and pair once.

preferences.name: configPath
preferences.title: Client Configuration File
preferences.description: Private JSON file containing the local hub URL and token. Defaults to ~/.argo/client.json. Credentials are never stored in Raycast preferences.

preferences.name: portStart
preferences.title: Discovery Port Range Start
preferences.description: Only Mac loopback ports are checked. Forward server bridges into this range. Maximum 64 ports.

preferences.name: portEnd
preferences.title: Discovery Port Range End
preferences.description: Last Mac loopback port to check for signed Argo bridge identities.

preferences.name: hcSocketPath
preferences.title: Herdr Socket Path
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to an existing herdr-core Unix socket. Leave blank for HC_SOCKET or the official default session path. Discovery never starts a core.
